title: Think creatively

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Translate identity into spatial experiences so people can encounter and use it rather than only see a printed logo.
strategic_value: Wave-inspired furniture, surface graphics and material-aware signs can connect Helsinki’s visual language to lived places.
demonstration: This expanded webpage-section capture places creative prompts above six photographs of furniture, decals, existing surfaces, trail markers, material-based signs and fixtures.
practical_value: Use existing surfaces and materials inventively, and consider a functional spatial interpretation of a brand shape.

content_islands.name: Creative prompts
content_islands.spec: Start with the invitation to avoid generic structures and favor sustainable choices.

content_islands.name: Six spatial applications
content_islands.spec: Keep each photograph with its caption, from wave-like seating through facade fixtures.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text encourages designs that activate residents and build a future Helsinki rather than merely decorate stock structures.
reference_purposes.Application: Photographs show furniture, decals, trail identifiers and signs made with site materials.
reference_purposes.Expression: The examples turn wave shapes, color and typography into physical details.
